video_prompts.prompt: Gentle zoom in on Jesus and the children smiling, subtle glowing light particles floating in the air. Soft and peaceful motion.
Soft wind blowing through Jesus' hair, moonlight shining down gently on the hill.
Guards slowly approaching with torches, soft flickering fire light, gentle camera movement.
Camera gently following Jesus as he slowly walks carrying the heavy cross, dust particles floating in the sunlight.
Beautiful glowing light particles swirling around the cross softly, warm light expanding outward gently.
The large stone slowly rolling to cover the cave entrance, dust settling softly.
Bright warm light bursting out slowly from the open tomb, glowing light particles floating upward.
Angel's wings glowing and softly moving, beautiful sparkles falling gently around the angel.
Jesus glowing softly, smiling happily as he turns to everyone, warm light radiating outward.
Beautiful soft sparkles floating in the air around the smiling people, joyful and dreamlike atmosphere.
Jesus gently hugging the child, camera slowly zooming out to show the peaceful scene, soft light particles.
